documents.title: Notice of Application - Under the Planning Act - 207, 209, 211, 213, 215, 217, and 219 Jarvis Street

claims.text: A developer wants to build a 102.8-meter mixed-use building with mostly residential units and some commercial space at 207-219 Jarvis Street.

sources.quote: amend the Official Plan and Zoning By-law 569-2013 to allow for a 102.8-metre mixed-use building containing 23,000 square metres of gross floor area comprising a maximum of 22,800 square metres of residential gross floor area and a minimum of 200 square metres of non-residential gross floor area.

claims.text: The application asks the City to change its Official Plan and zoning rules for this site.
